additional_context: The issue concerns rendering of an external US Core ValueSet in another IG, not a FHIR core conformance definition. Current core source has Condition active in source/fhir.ini and its separate core Condition Category Codes ValueSet already has a title. No Confluence references or related final core issue requiring source changes were found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no FHIR core source edits because the applied fix belongs to IG Publisher/tooling outside this checkout.
